project_name.justification: The press release is titled 'Advanced Gold Exploration Inc. Acquires Additional Copper Exploration Claims at its Buck Lake Property'.

company_name.justification: The press release is from 'Advanced Gold Exploration Inc. (CSE: AUEX) ("AUEX " or the "Company")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO is identified in the text: 'Mr. Jim Atkinson, CEO of AUEX commented...' and in the contact information: 'James Atkinson, M.Sc., P. Geo., CEO Advanced Gold Exploration Inc.'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction involves the acquisition of 81 new claims by staking, not the acquisition of a percentage interest in the project from a partner. The text states the company 'quickly staked the areas indicated as having potential'.

primary_commodity.justification: The press release headline is 'Acquires Additional Copper Exploration Claims at its Buck Lake Property' and the text refers to it as 'our very exciting copper project - Buck Lake Property'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Buck Lake project, as stated in the headline and throughout the text. The source link is provided at the bottom of the article: 'To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/216274'.

currency.justification: The article does not mention any financial consideration or currency for the acquisition of the claims.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The article describes the acquisition as staking new claims ('we quickly staked the areas') and does not mention any cash payments as consideration.

share_payments_raw.justification: The article does not mention any share payments as consideration for the new claims.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The article does not mention any combined cash and share payments for the new claims.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The article does not mention any issuance of shares as part of this transaction.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The article does not mention any share warrants as part of this transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: The article does not mention any options as part of this transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of this transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The company states it 'will expand our upcoming exploration program to include these new claims' but does not provide a specific commitment in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The company states it 'will expand our upcoming exploration program' but does not provide a specific monetary value for the commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The article does not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or similar royalty as part of the transaction.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states the total area of the property after the acquisition: 'The Property now consists of a total of 260 single-cell mining claims that covers 6,150 hectares'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit is specified in the same sentence: 'The Property now consists of a total of 260 single-cell mining claims that covers 6,150 hectares'.

resource_size.justification: The article mentions historical drill results and a 43-101 report that indicates 'high merit', but it does not contain a quantified mineral resource estimate with mass or volume units (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The company is identified as 'Advanced Gold Exploration Inc. (CSE: AUEX)' in the first paragraph.
